# Device protocol

Text lines over USB serial at 9600 baud, 8N1. Each command is one line ending in `\n`; `\r` is ignored.

- Maximum line length is 64 characters (`ERR LINE` above that).
- Device and keyword arguments are case-insensitive. This crate always sends upper case.
- LCD text keeps its case.
- The strip has 46 LEDs; the LCD has 2 rows of 16 characters.

## Commands

### Set the mode

Switches the board between demo, active and off. The only command that works in every mode.

```text
MODE <mode>
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `mode` | `DEMO`, `ACTIVE` or `OFF` |

- Valid in: every mode
- Example: `MODE ACTIVE`

### 4-digit clock

Switches the 4-digit display to the clock. With a time it sets the clock and runs; without, it resumes the saved time.

```text
4DIGIT TIME [HH:MM]
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `HH:MM` | 24-hour time, hour 0-23, minute 0-59 |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `4DIGIT TIME 12:34`

### 4-digit startwatch

Switches to the counting-up startwatch. With seconds it starts there; `PAUSE` freezes it; without an argument it resumes.

```text
4DIGIT STARTWATCH [seconds|PAUSE]
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `seconds` | 0-359999 |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `4DIGIT STARTWATCH 90`

### 4-digit timer

Switches to the counting-down timer. With seconds it starts there; `PAUSE` freezes it; without an argument it resumes.

```text
4DIGIT TIMER [seconds|PAUSE]
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `seconds` | 0-359999 |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `4DIGIT TIMER 300`

### 6-digit set

Shows a value and stops changing.

```text
6DIGIT SET <value>
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `value` | 0-999999 |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `6DIGIT SET 42`

### 6-digit reset

Shows 0 and stops changing.

```text
6DIGIT RESET
```

No arguments.

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `6DIGIT RESET`

### 6-digit count up

Counts up from a value. A hidden counter keeps running.

```text
6DIGIT COUNTUP <from> [step_ms]
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `from` | 0-999999 |
| `step_ms` | 1-65535, default 100 |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `6DIGIT COUNTUP 100 1000`

### 6-digit count down

Counts down from a value and stops at 0.

```text
6DIGIT COUNTDOWN <from> [step_ms]
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `from` | 0-999999 |
| `step_ms` | 1-65535, default 100 |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `6DIGIT COUNTDOWN 100`

### LCD row

Writes text on a row, or clears the row when no text is given. Row 2 is overwritten by the stats in `DEMO` mode.

```text
LCD ROW <row> [text]
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `row` | 1 or 2 |
| `text` | printable ASCII, 1-16 characters, case kept |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `LCD ROW 1 Biggus`

### LCD clear

Clears both rows.

```text
LCD CLEAR
```

No arguments.

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `LCD CLEAR`

### LED range

Sets every LED in `[start, end)` to a colour and animation, replacing their old state. LEDs outside the range keep theirs.

```text
LED_STRIP RANGE <start> <end> COLOR <RRGGBB> ANIM <anim> [period_ms]
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `start, end` | `start < end <= 46` |
| `RRGGBB` | hex colour |
| `anim` | `SOLID`, `BLINK` or `PULSE`; `SOLID` takes no period |
| `period_ms` | 1-65535, default 500 for `BLINK` and 1000 for `PULSE` |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `LED_STRIP RANGE 23 46 COLOR 0000FF ANIM PULSE 1000`

### LED range off

Turns off the LEDs in `[start, end)`.

```text
LED_STRIP RANGE <start> <end> CLEAR
```

| Argument | Values |
|---|---|
| `start, end` | `start < end <= 46` |

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `LED_STRIP RANGE 0 23 CLEAR`

### LED all off

Turns off all LEDs.

```text
LED_STRIP CLEAR
```

No arguments.

- Valid in: `ACTIVE` only; otherwise `ERR MODE`
- Example: `LED_STRIP CLEAR`

## Replies

| Reply | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `OK` | Command applied |
| `ERR MODE` | Device command sent outside `ACTIVE` |
| `ERR UNKNOWN` | Unknown device |
| `ERR ARGS` | Missing or malformed argument |
| `ERR RANGE` | Number or range out of bounds |
| `ERR LINE` | Line longer than 64 characters |
